scope: Editorial visual screening; not independent mycological review

cards.name: Camperol
cards.observation: Ring looks substantial for the labelled thin, fleeting ring; reduce its visual permanence.

cards.name: Ou de reig
cards.observation: Expose the free white sac edge more clearly; soil and basal swelling obscure the volva.

cards.name: Reig bord
cards.observation: Red cap, white warts and basal veil remnants read consistently at overview scale.

cards.name: Pixacà
cards.observation: Brown cap, white warts and basal bands are distinguishable; no conspicuous overview mismatch.

cards.name: Farinera borda
cards.observation: Sac rim is present, but dirt and swelling dominate the volva close-up. Clarify the separate membrane and bulb; do not claim the volva is absent.

cards.name: Cogomassa
cards.observation: Improve separation of saclike volva from the swollen base; confirm in a full-size reference comparison before redrawing.

cards.name: Farinera pudent
cards.observation: Conical white cap is recognizable; clarify the basal sac in a full-size comparison.

cards.name: Cep negre
cards.observation: Stem netting and cap relief look overemphasized; compare with photographed European specimens before reducing detail.

cards.name: Cep
cards.observation: Raised coarse white net contradicts the visual impression of the labelled fine net. Make it finer, especially in panel 2; soften cap relief.

cards.name: Cep rogenc
cards.observation: Coarse netting and cap texture repeat the same bolete template; check species-specific texture against European references.

cards.name: Cep d’estiu
cards.observation: Full-stem netting is appropriate to the concept, but its relief is exaggerated; distinguish it from the other cep cards.

cards.name: Moixernó
cards.observation: Gill blades appear thick at overview scale; inspect blade spacing and attachment against references before deciding on a redraw.

cards.name: Pet de llop gegant
cards.observation: Ball-shaped fruitbody and white young interior are mutually consistent at overview scale.

cards.name: Rossinyol
cards.observation: Earlier taper correction is visible. Blunt descending folds remain distinguishable; retain them when adjusting other gilled species.

cards.name: Cama de perdiu
cards.observation: Copper cap, dark descending gills and stem colours are mutually consistent at overview scale.

cards.name: Candeleta de vorada
cards.observation: Pale zoned cap and fine gills show no conspicuous overview contradiction.

cards.name: Bolet de tinta
cards.observation: Compare the cut specimen's cap shape with its intended age; do not mix a young closed cylinder with a mature expanded section without a label.

cards.name: Cortinari metzinós
cards.observation: Panel 3 shows fuzzy stem fibres but makes veil remnants hard to distinguish from ordinary surface texture. Use a clearer age-labelled veil detail, without inventing a persistent ring.

cards.name: Cortinari mortal
cards.observation: Veil remnant reads like a fringed collar. Clarify fine cobwebby remnants and soften cap relief; absence of a conspicuous veil in a mature specimen is not itself an error.

cards.name: Trompeta de la mort
cards.observation: Hollow trumpet and longitudinal section are consistent at overview scale.

cards.name: Camagroc
cards.observation: Yellow hollow stem and relatively smooth underside are consistent at overview scale.

cards.name: Fals camagroc
cards.observation: Underside folds look strongly sculpted; compare their relief with references before further smoothing.

cards.name: Pollancró
cards.observation: Wood substrate, clustering and ring read consistently at overview scale.

cards.name: Carner bord
cards.observation: Notched attachment is not clearly demonstrated by the selected view. Add a view that actually shows the notch; a labelled young yellow-gill stage would clarify the stated colour transition.

cards.name: Galerina metzinosa
cards.observation: Wood substrate, rusty gills and ring remnant are recognizable; no conspicuous overview contradiction.

cards.name: Bolet de greix
cards.observation: Brainlike folds and chambered cutaway are highly stylized; validate the section against an actual longitudinal specimen before changing it.

cards.name: Llengua de bou
cards.observation: Revised flatter cap and smaller teeth improve the earlier issue. No new conspicuous structural contradiction in the enlarged card.

cards.name: Fals rossinyol
cards.observation: Orange funnel and fine forked gill concept read consistently at overview scale.

cards.name: Llenega blanca
cards.observation: Pale cap and broad waxy descending gills are consistent at overview scale.

cards.name: Llenega
cards.observation: Viscous dark cap and pale gills are consistent at overview scale; a still image cannot prove viscosity.

cards.name: Marçot
cards.observation: Grey cap and robust pale body show no conspicuous overview contradiction.

cards.name: Carlet
cards.observation: Gill spacing appears unusually open in the overview; check against species reference before requesting a denser redraw.

cards.name: Inocibe de Patouillard
cards.observation: Fibrous pointed cap and reddish staining are consistently represented at overview scale.

cards.name: Pinetell bord
cards.observation: White and yellow latex should be explicitly presented as a change over time, rather than unexplained simultaneous colours.

cards.name: Pinetell
cards.observation: Latex drops and surface relief are excessively glossy/sculpted. Keep diagnostic orange latex but make the depiction more natural.

cards.name: Rovelló
cards.observation: Wine-red latex drops look like thick syrup. Reduce drop volume and gloss without changing the diagnostic colour.

cards.name: Rovelló de cabra
cards.observation: Hair is rendered as long stiff strands; make the woolly margin softer and less uniformly spiky. This is a naturalism correction, not a claim that a hairy cap is impossible.

cards.name: Lleterola roja
cards.observation: Wrinkled orange cap and white latex are internally consistent at overview scale.

cards.name: Cigró
cards.observation: Clarify the timing of the pinkish cut-flesh colour so the panel does not imply an immediate uniform change.

cards.name: Palometa metzinosa
cards.observation: Revised compact form and size cue distinguish it better from Apagallums. No new conspicuous overview mismatch; this is not identification approval.

cards.name: Pimpinella morada
cards.observation: Violet tones and ringless stem are consistent at overview scale.

cards.name: Pet de llop perlat
cards.observation: Pear shape, spines and apical opening read consistently at overview scale.

cards.name: Pet de llop gros
cards.observation: Panel 3 divides one cut body sharply into white and brown halves to illustrate maturation. Replace with two separately labelled ages; the current composition implies a misleading internal arrangement.

cards.name: Apagallums
cards.observation: Double-edged ring reads as two independent stacked frilly rings in the main specimen and panel 1. Redraw one coherent double-edged ring and keep all specimens consistent.

cards.name: Camasec
cards.observation: Slender grassland form and spaced gills are consistent at overview scale.

cards.name: Múrgola
cards.observation: Pitted cap and continuous hollow longitudinal section are consistent at overview scale.

cards.name: Bolet d’olivera
cards.observation: Clustered wood-associated orange fruitbodies and descending gills are consistent at overview scale.

cards.name: Paxil·le tòxic
cards.observation: Rolled margin and darkening areas are visible; no conspicuous overview contradiction.

cards.name: Gírgola de panical
cards.observation: Robust form and descending gills are consistent at overview scale; host plant identity was not independently checked.

cards.name: Gírgola
cards.observation: Overlapping wood-associated fans and short lateral stems are consistent at overview scale.

cards.name: Peu de rata daurat
cards.observation: Golden branching coral form reads consistently; the drawing alone cannot establish the species.

cards.name: Peu de rata bord
cards.observation: Salmon branches and yellow tips are represented consistently at overview scale.

cards.name: Matagent
cards.observation: Verify the intensity and timing of blue staining against a photographed cut specimen before changing it; do not infer an exact reaction speed from a still image.

cards.name: Llora aspra
cards.observation: Mixed cap colours and white gills are consistent. Flexibility requires an explanatory demonstration, not merely a still close-up.

cards.name: Llora verda
cards.observation: Earlier flatter mosaic correction is visible; no new conspicuous overview contradiction.

cards.name: Molleric granellut
cards.observation: Stem dots look like recessed pores rather than surface granules. Clarify the small glandular dots and soften the cap relief.

cards.name: Molleric de calceta
cards.observation: Ring and pore textures are heavily stylized; compare a full-size reference before declaring an anatomical error.

cards.name: Fredolic metzinós
cards.observation: White robust stem is improved. Flatten the lifted cap scales and choose a gill view that visibly demonstrates the labelled notch.

cards.name: Fredolic gros
cards.observation: Main underside and panel 3 depict thick blunt folds flowing into the stem, despite the label for notched gills. Redraw distinct true blades with the attachment clearly visible, consistently in the cutaway too.

cards.name: Fredolic
cards.observation: Main and cut stems look robust despite the repeated thin-stem label. Use a more slender representative form and finer cap fibres; natural variation prevents a precise ratio claim.

cards.name: Tòfona negra
cards.observation: White gleba veins form a regular crack-like mesh. Make the marbling finer and irregularly branching, following the versioned profile.

cards.name: Mataparent
cards.observation: Pink underside reads as elongated maze-like grooves, especially in panel 1. Redraw distinct small pores. Cap relief is also overdone; cracking can occur, so do not treat every crack as an error.
